purpose: Replace the failed high-dimensional learned v468 A/D heads with one deterministic, train-only, episode-grouped five-fold KNN4 residual probe. This contract does not authorize S1, zero-update rollout, policy training, formal RL, hidden/final access, or submission.

immutable_inputs.paired_data: passed immutable v461 endpoint200 public train40/right15 data, selection, generation report, final audit, and all row hashes
immutable_inputs.folds: exact immutable v461 outer episode folds; 3 held right episodes and 12 fit right episodes per fold
immutable_inputs.world_model: exact frozen v169 release and library closure already bound by the passed v468 preregistration
forbidden: official reward during model selection or fitting
branch identity as a runtime feature

v169_cache.common_seed_formula: int.from_bytes(sha256('v466/1616/{episode}/{start}').digest()[:8], 'little') mod 2**31; identical for all five branches of one context
v169_cache.requested_first: in immutable context order and branch order factual,no_transport,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4, compute frozen-v169 requested-action endpoints Bb for exactly 1000 requests in microbatches of 4
v169_cache.canonical_second: in the same immutable context order, replace only future[:,7:13] with history[-1,7:13], preserve all other action dimensions, and compute frozen-v169 canonical endpoints Bnt for exactly 200 requests in microbatches of 4
v169_cache.closure: atomically bind v169 release/library/source hashes, v461 row/action hashes, seed per context, request order, endpoint array hashes, and cache file SHA256
v169_cache.resource_order: compute requested and canonical populations sequentially; never concatenate them; unload v169 and empty CUDA cache before all KNN/PCA-free CPU work

frozen_targets.no_transport: E_star_no_transport is exact zero and runtime E_no_transport is hard-set exact zero
frozen_targets.controls: context-only and phase-shuffle candidates use the identical B_b and identical C_hat as action; only E_hat differs

frozen_features.context_raw: authoritative same-request branch_context_rgb[0] uint8 converted to float32, reshape (8,32,8,32,3), mean over axes (1,3), flatten to 192 values
frozen_features.context_normalization: fit-fold per-dimension mean and population standard deviation with floor 1e-4; no PCA
frozen_features.action_raw: 54 request-only float values: right6 endpoint delta future[-1,7:13]-history[-1,7:13] followed by the 48-value anchor-relative path (future[:,7:13]-history[-1,7:13]).reshape(-1)
frozen_features.action_normalization: fit-fold per-dimension mean and population standard deviation with floor 1e-4; no PCA
frozen_features.runtime_availability: all features come only from the request context/history/future; no episode, start index, branch label, target, reward, or outcome is an input

frozen_estimator.weights: uniform arithmetic mean; no distance weighting
frozen_estimator.appearance_library: one C_star target per fit context; distance is mean squared normalized context difference
frozen_estimator.transport_library: four E_star targets per fit context, exactly factual,scale_0p4,scale_1p25,reverse_direction_0p4; no_transport is excluded and hard-zero
frozen_estimator.action_distance: mean squared normalized 54D action difference plus mean squared normalized 192D context difference
frozen_estimator.context_only_control: same KNN4 library, target representation, normalization, tie-break, and averaging; distance uses context term and a zero action term for every query/library pair
frozen_estimator.phase_shuffle_control: same KNN4 estimator but replace each query action descriptor with the preregistered v468 within-episode half-rotation donor action of the same branch; retain the original query context descriptor
frozen_estimator.tie_break: stable ascending tuple (float64 distance, SHA256 of the fit request history+future float32 action bytes, SHA256 of the fit context RGB bytes); target-independent and contains no branch identity, episode, start, reward, or outcome
frozen_estimator.output: average the four stored int16 residual RGB maps in float32; no output rank reduction, scaling, clipping, learned network, optimizer, or checkpoint selection
frozen_estimator.all200: only after the immutable five-fold S0 passes, build exactly one deployment library from all 200 contexts with the same formulas and hyperparameters

unchanged_s0_gates.early_stop: hard-stop after a second failed fold because passing_folds_min=4 is mathematically unreachable; do not build all200 library

runtime_guards.left_or_gate0: return requested-action frozen-v169 output bitexact for all 8 frames
runtime_guards.frames_0_to_6: always bitexact to requested-action frozen-v169 output
runtime_guards.frame_7: only frame allowed to change for an enabled request
runtime_guards.no_transport: E exact zero; candidate may contain only the frozen KNN4 C correction
runtime_guards.input_shapes: fail closed unless context is N x 5 x H x W x 3, history is N x 4 x 14, future is N x 8 x 14, and frozen-v169 output is N x 8 x H x W x 3 uint8

evidence_before_freeze.v468_failure: two folds failed: overall ratios 1.014402 and 1.022139; action-vs-context 0.996305 and 0.999534; action-vs-phase-shuffle 0.996191 and 0.999340; both had zero episode wins
evidence_before_freeze.raw_delta_family_probe: public train-only outer-fold pooled deployable KNN4 on raw D reached aggregate D/zero 0.809015, wins 410/800 and positive cosine 0.93125, whereas fixed ridge alpha1 reached 1.05075
evidence_before_freeze.selection_disclosure: the raw-D outer-fold public-train results were already used to select KNN4 over fixed ridge1 and are iterative public-train development evidence, not an independent untouched holdout
evidence_before_freeze.limitation: raw-D scale_0p4 and reverse branches exceeded 1.03 in several folds; therefore raw-D results select only the KNN4 estimator family. They do not pass this residual-E contract and do not authorize deployment. The residual C/E S0 is a single-shot preregistered public-train test, but because the same public fold structure informed the estimator-family choice it must not be represented as an independent untouched holdout.

resource_budget.gpu: only frozen-v169 cache inference, microbatch4; KNN work is CPU-only after unload
resource_budget.ram_estimate: under 5 GiB peak with int16 C/E libraries and fold-at-a-time predictions
resource_budget.persistent_storage_estimate: under 1.2 GiB including uint8 v169 endpoints, int16 residual libraries, reports, and temporary fold outputs
resource_budget.expected_wall_seconds: approximately 240-480 seconds including frozen-v169 cache; fail closed at 600 seconds

promotion.s0_pass: authorizes only packaging of the all200 diagnostic parent and one preregistered public S1; it does not authorize RL
promotion.s1_pass: may authorize only raw-Pi0.5 zero-update trace under a separately frozen contract
promotion.formal: formal RL, if ever authorized, must still start from raw Pi0.5 under the official fixed-budget contract; no v169 policy lineage is formal
